completed.title: Interview complete
completed.subtitle: Here's how you did on each question.

expired.title: Time's up
expired.subtitle: Your time ran out, so your answers were submitted.

terminated.title: Interview ended early
terminated.subtitle: Your interview was stopped and submitted with the answers you gave.

autoSubmitted.title: Interview submitted
autoSubmitted.subtitle: Your interview was submitted automatically with the answers you gave.

terminated.heading: Interview Terminated
terminated.description: Your interview has been automatically terminated due to multiple violations of the exam integrity rules (navigating away from the window or exiting full-screen).

violationWarning.defaultDescription: Navigating away from the interview screen is being logged as a violation
violationWarning.finalWarning: This is your final warning. One more violation will end your interview.

autoSubmitLoader.messageOffline: Don't worry — your answers are saved. We'll submit automatically when you're back online.
autoSubmitLoader.messageError: {{errorText}} Your answers are saved — please try again.
autoSubmitLoader.messageErrorGenericFallback: Something went wrong submitting your interview.
autoSubmitLoader.messageSuccess: All done! Your results are being prepared now.
autoSubmitLoader.messageSubmitting: Hang tight — we're saving your answers and preparing your results. Please don't close this page.
autoSubmitLoader.waitingOffline: We'll retry automatically when you're back online.
autoSubmitLoader.waitingError: Tap “Try Again” to resubmit. Your progress is safe.
autoSubmitLoader.waitingSubmitting: Please wait, do not close or refresh this page.

tabSwitch.title: Tab Switch Detected
tabSwitch.description: Navigating away from the interview screen is not allowed. Continued violations will end your interview.

fullscreenExit.title: Fullscreen Exit Detected
fullscreenExit.description: Exiting fullscreen is not allowed. Continued violations will end your interview.

fullscreenRestore.title: Fullscreen required
fullscreenRestore.description: Your interview must stay in fullscreen.

windowResize.title: Window Resize Detected
windowResize.description: Resizing or un-maximizing the window is not allowed. Continued violations will end your interview.

noFace.title: Candidate Not Detected
noFace.description: Ensure you are properly positioned in front of the camera.

noFaceGuidance.title: Keep Face in Frame
noFaceGuidance.description: Please keep your face centered in the frame.

multipleFaces.title: Multiple People Detected
multipleFaces.description: Only you should be visible on the interview screen. Please ensure no one else is in view.

prohibitedObject.title: Prohibited Device Detected
prohibitedObject.description: Please put away the {{object}} to continue the interview.

multipleDevices.title: Prohibited Devices Detected
multipleDevices.description: Please put away your {{object}} to continue the interview.

cellPhone.title: Cell Phone Detected
cellPhone.description: Mobile phones are not permitted during the interview. Please put away your phone to continue.

notLooking.title: Look at the Camera
notLooking.description: Please keep your eyes on the screen. Looking away repeatedly will be flagged.

eyesClosed.title: Eyes Closed Detected
eyesClosed.description: Please keep your eyes open and stay focused during the interview.

windowFocus.title: Interview Window Lost Focus
windowFocus.description: You clicked outside the interview window. Keep the interview window active at all times.

cameraOff.title: Camera Turned Off
cameraOff.description: Your camera stopped sending video. Turn it back on to continue the interview.

cameraOffHint.title: Your Camera Stopped
cameraOffHint.description: Turn your camera back on. If it stays off, it will count as a violation.

lookingAway.title: Looking Away Too Long
lookingAway.description: You looked away from the screen for too long. Keep your attention on the interview.

externalDisplay.title: External Display Detected
externalDisplay.description: An external display was detected. Disconnect all external monitors to continue.

screenSharing.title: Screen Sharing Detected
screenSharing.description: Screen sharing or mirroring was detected. Close all sharing apps immediately.

securityMonitor.title: Security Monitor Interrupted
securityMonitor.description: The security monitor was interrupted. This may indicate a tamper attempt.

windowAction.title: Window Action Detected
windowAction.description: The interview window was minimized or closed. Please keep it in focus at all times.

overlay.title: Overlay Window Detected
overlay.description: An app is showing a see-through window on top of the interview. Close it to continue.

generic.title: Security Violation Detected
generic.description: A security policy violation was detected. Please resolve it immediately.

blockedApp.title: Blocked App Detected
blockedApp.description: An app that isn't allowed during the interview was opened.

aiTool.title: AI Assistant Detected
aiTool.description: An AI assistant app was running during the interview.

renamedApp.title: Disguised App Detected
renamedApp.description: A blocked app was running under a different name.

mirroredDisplay.title: Screen Mirroring Detected
mirroredDisplay.description: Your screen is being duplicated to another display. Stop mirroring and unplug the extra display now.

remoteSession.title: Remote Desktop Detected
remoteSession.description: This computer was being used through a remote desktop session.

virtualMachine.title: Virtual Machine Detected
virtualMachine.description: The interview was running inside a virtual machine, which isn't allowed.

faceMismatch.title: Identity Check Failed
faceMismatch.description: We couldn't confirm it's still you on camera. Stay alone in front of the camera, face the screen and keep your face well lit. If this keeps happening, your interview will end.

faceUnclear.title: Face the Camera
faceUnclear.description: We can't see your face clearly enough to confirm it's you. Face the screen and make sure your face is well lit.

violationLimit.title: Interview Ended
violationLimit.description: You reached {{violations}} compliance violations. Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.

faceMismatch.title: Interview Ended
faceMismatch.description: Identity verification failed repeatedly, so we could not confirm it was still you on camera. Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.

networkDisconnects.title: Interview Ended
networkDisconnects.description: Your connection dropped {{disconnects}} times. Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.

timeExpired.title: Time's Up
timeExpired.description: Your interview time has ended. Your answers have been submitted.

electronSecurity.title: Interview Ended
electronSecurity.description: A security policy violation ended your interview. It has been submitted with the answers you completed.

generic.title: Interview Ended
generic.description: Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.

desktopUpdate.heading: Update the desktop app
desktopUpdate.description: This version of the LetsHyre desktop app is out of date. Close it, install the latest version, then start your interview again.

timer.label: Time remaining
timer.warningHint: Start wrapping up your current answer.

offline.message: You're offline. Your answer is saved on this device. Disconnect {{disconnects}} of {{max}}.

held.restrikeNow: Counts as another violation at the next check
held.restrikePending: This will count as another violation if it stays.

fix.tabSwitch: Stay on this tab until you submit your last answer.
fix.fullscreenExit: Press the button below to go back to fullscreen, and stay there.
fix.windowResize: Keep the window maximized until the interview ends.
fix.windowFocus: Close other windows and click only inside the interview.
fix.noFace: Sit facing the camera with your whole face in the frame.
fix.multipleFaces: Ask anyone else to leave the room, then carry on.
fix.prohibitedObject: Move the {{object}} out of the room or well out of the camera's view.
fix.multipleDevices: Move your {{object}} out of the room or well out of the camera's view.
fix.cellPhone: Switch your phone off and put it out of reach and out of view.
fix.lookingAway: Look at the screen while you answer.
fix.cameraOff: Turn your camera back on and make sure nothing is covering it.
fix.faceMismatch: Face the camera in good light, with nobody else in view.

electron.externalDisplay: Unplug every extra monitor, TV or projector now.
electron.mirroredDisplay: Turn off screen mirroring and unplug the extra display.
electron.screenSharing: Stop sharing your screen and close the sharing app.
electron.blockedApp: Close the app and keep it closed until the interview ends.
electron.aiTool: Quit the AI assistant and keep it closed.
electron.overlay: Close the app that is drawing over the interview.
electron.renamedApp: Quit the app and don't open it again during the interview.
electron.remoteSession: End the remote session and use this computer directly.
electron.virtualMachine: Take the interview on a regular computer, not a virtual machine.
electron.securityMonitor: Don't close or change the desktop app's security tools.
electron.windowAction: Keep the interview window open and on screen.
electron.generic: Close anything you opened besides the interview.

rules.title: Before you begin
rules.intro: This interview is proctored through your camera and screen. Here is what the proctoring looks for.

strikes.window: Leaving the interview window, switching tabs or exiting fullscreen
strikes.people: Someone else in view, or nobody in view
strikes.devices: A phone or another prohibited device in view
strikes.apps: Apps, screen sharing or extra displays the desktop app blocks

rules.warningsTitle: These only give you a warning

warnings.faceFrame: Your face briefly leaving the frame
warnings.lighting: Poor lighting or an unclear view of your face
warnings.cameraPause: Your camera pausing for a moment

limits.strikes: After {{max}} strikes the interview ends and your answers are submitted.
limits.held: A device left in view, or a camera left off, costs another strike every {{seconds}} seconds.
limits.face: If your face doesn't match your photo {{inARow}} times in a row, or {{total}} times in all, the interview ends.
limits.network: If your internet drops {{max}} times, the interview is submitted. Drops are not strikes.

camera.title: Camera check
camera.description: Let's make sure the camera can see you clearly before the interview starts.

checks.oneFace: Only your face is in view
checks.centred: Your face is in the middle of the frame

camera.passed: All set. You can start the interview.
camera.unavailable: The camera check can't run on this device. You can still continue.
camera.skipHint: Still not passing? You can continue anyway. This will be noted for the reviewer.
